title: Add the vessel client gate
message:
Add the vessel client gate

A raw native MSDP session locks and fires on a contact at sea, checks the
twelve S8 variables against the staged hulls and shipstatus, and checks
that each empties ashore.

title: Report the vessel client data over MSDP
message:
Report the vessel client data over MSDP

SHIP_ID, SHIP_TARGET, the armor and internal tables by arc, sails, rudder,
crew stamina, and one table per weapon and per contact join the nine vessel
variables, refreshed on the vessel tick and emptied ashore (study 3.3.9).

title: Close S7 in the study docs: merged, help synced
message:
Close S7 in the study docs: merged, help synced

MR !12 merged S7 as merge commit cce9ff323 and its vessel help is on
production (help sync plan 83ce5db82aad, 1 addition and 5 updates). The
Phase 7 record moves verbatim to the history document with the merge
note, and the S7 design values and carry-overs, now built, return to
3.3.7 and 3.3.9 there. The entry point's status table records the merge,
the S8 branch and base tag, an S8-only list of values still to build,
and an empty active step for the S8 plan.

title: Regenerate help.hlp in the help catalog's order
message:
Regenerate help.hlp in the help catalog's order

The S7 help sync (plan 83ce5db82aad) repaired the development
projection: S7 placed the new SHIPRENOWN entry by hand before the
SHIPHIRE entry, while the engine projects it, in the catalog's order,
after the SHIP-ADMIN entry. The file now equals the database projection
on development and production (17b5729a686a).
